Require Export strictness.cbpv.typing strictness.cbpv.semantics.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Peano_dec.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Definition non_func {n} (B : CompTy n) :=
  forall q A B', B <> CAbs q A B'.

Definition LRM {n} (B : Ty n CompFlag)
  (LR_maybe : Ty n CompFlag -> Clos CompFlag -> forall m,fin m -> Prop)
  (LR_no : Ty n CompFlag -> Clos CompFlag -> forall m,fin m -> Prop)
 mInner (γ : attrs mInner) mOuter mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner) ρ M :=
  ((down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x = Strict ->
    (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M) /\
    (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\
      LR_no B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x)) /\
  ((down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x <> Strict ->
    EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_maybe B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x).

Fixpoint LR_maybe {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (x : fin mLower) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | VUnit => fun C => C = Unit
    | VThunk γ B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (HInner : mOuter <= mInner)
        (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
        down_env_until γ mOuter Hn = γScoped /\
        down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
        C = Thunk mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
        LRM B LR_maybe LR_no mInner γInner mOuter mLower x Hnlower ρ M
    | VProd A1 A2 => fun C => exists W1 W2,
      C = Pair W1 W2 /\ LR_maybe A1 W1 mLower x /\ LR_maybe A2 W2 mLower x
    | VSum A1 A2 => fun C => exists W',
      (C = Inl W' /\ LR_maybe A1 W' mLower x) \/ (C = Inr W' /\ LR_maybe A2 W' mLower x)
    | CF A => fun C => exists W, C = Return W /\ LR_maybe A W mLower x
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n)
        (HInner : mOuter <= mInner) (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR_maybe A W mLower x ->
        EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M \/
        exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR_maybe B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x)
    end) C

with LR_no {n k} (τ : Ty n k) (C : Clos k) mLower (x : fin mLower) :=
    (match τ in Ty _ k return Clos k -> Prop with
    | CAbs q A B => fun C =>
      exists mOuter mInner γScoped γInner ρ M (Hn : mOuter <= n) (HInner : mOuter <= mInner)
        (HLower : mLower <= mOuter) (Hnlower : mLower <= mInner),
      down_env_until γInner mOuter HInner = γScoped /\
      C = Closure mOuter mInner γScoped ρ M /\
      (forall W, LR_maybe A W mLower x ->
        (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M) /\
        (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M \/
            exists T, EvalComp (q .: γInner) ((mOuter W↓ W) .: ρ) M T /\ LR_no B (mOuter T↓ T) mLower x))
    | _ => fun C => False
    end) C.

Definition ρ_not_ok {n} γ (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower (x : fin mLower) (Hnlower : mLower <= n) :=
    (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x = Strict /\
    (down_env_until ρ mLower Hnlower) x = Absent /\
    (forall (j : fin n), j <> up_fin_until n Hnlower x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) mLower x).

Definition ρ_maybe_ok {n} γ (ρ : env n) (Γ : context n) mLower (x : fin mLower) (Hnlower : mLower <= n) :=
    (down_env_until γ mLower Hnlower) x <> Strict /\
    (down_env_until ρ mLower Hnlower) x = Absent /\
    (forall (j : fin n), j <> up_fin_until n Hnlower x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) mLower x).

Definition SemVWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) V (A : ValTy n) :=
    forall ρ mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= n),
        (ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower -> EvalValFail ρ V) /\
        (ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
          EvalValFail ρ V \/ exists W, EvalVal γ ρ V W /\ LR_maybe A W mLower x).

Definition SemCWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) M (B : CompTy n) :=
    forall ρ mLower x (Hnlower : mLower <= n),
        (ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
            (non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M) /\
            (~ non_func B -> EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_no B T mLower x)) /\
        (ρ_maybe_ok γ ρ Γ mLower x Hnlower ->
            EvalCompFail ρ M \/ exists T, EvalComp γ ρ M T /\ LR_maybe B T mLower x).

Section SemTyping.

Context {n : nat} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n).

End SemTyping.

Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax strictness.cbpv.typing.

From Coq Require Export PeanoNat.

From Coq Require Export Bool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Psatz.

Inductive Clos : Kind ->  Type :=
| Absent : Clos ValFlag
| Unit : Clos ValFlag
| Thunk (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter)  (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp mInner) : Clos ValFlag
| Pair (W1 W2 : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Inl (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Inr (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos ValFlag
| Return (W : Clos ValFlag) : Clos CompFlag
| Closure (mOuter : nat) mInner (γ' : attrs mOuter) (ρ : fin mInner -> Clos ValFlag) (M : Comp (S mInner)) : Clos CompFlag.

Definition ClosValue := Clos ValFlag.

Definition ClosComp := Clos CompFlag.

Definition env n := fin n -> ClosValue.

Definition min_le : forall m n, min m n <= m := ltac:(lia).

Fixpoint down_clos {k} scope (C : Clos k) : Clos k :=
  match C with
  | Absent => Absent
  | Unit => Unit
  | Thunk n m γ' ρ M => Thunk (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
  | Pair W1 W2 => Pair (down_clos scope W1) (down_clos scope W2)
  | Inl W => Inl (down_clos scope W)
  | Inr W => Inr (down_clos scope W)
  | Return W => Return (down_clos scope W)
  | Closure n m γ' ρ M => Closure (min n scope) m (down_env_until γ' (min n scope) (min_le n scope)) ρ M
  end.

Definition down_value := @down_clos ValFlag.

Definition down_comp := @down_clos CompFlag.

Notation "scope 'W↓' W" := (down_value scope W) (at level 85).

Notation "scope 'T↓' T" := (down_comp scope T) (at level 85).

Fixpoint well_scoped_clos {k} (C : Clos k) max_scope :=
  match C with
  | Absent => True
  | Unit => True
  | Thunk n m γ ρ M => n <= max_scope
  | Pair W1 W2 => well_scoped_clos W1 max_scope /\ well_scoped_clos W2 max_scope
  | Inl W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
  | Inr W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
  | Return W => well_scoped_clos W max_scope
  | Closure n _ _ ρ _  => n <= max_scope
end.

Definition well_scoped_value := @well_scoped_clos ValFlag.

Definition well_scoped_env {n} (ρ : env n) m := forall i, well_scoped_value (ρ i) m.

Definition well_scoped_comp := @well_scoped_clos CompFlag.

Inductive EvalVal {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) : Val n -> ClosValue -> Prop :=
  | E_Var i W :
    W = ρ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->
    W <> Absent ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vVar i) W

  | E_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    EvalVal γ ρ vUnit Unit

  | E_Thunk M γ' :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vThunk M) (Thunk n n γ' ρ M)

  | E_VPair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 W1 W2 :
    EvalVal γ1 ρ V1 W1 ->
    EvalVal γ2 ρ V2 W2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vPair V1 V2) (Pair W1 W2)

  | E_Inl V W :
    EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vInl V) (Inl W)

  | E_Inr V W :
    EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

    EvalVal γ ρ (vInr V) (Inr W)
.

Inductive EvalComp {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) : Comp n -> ClosComp -> Prop :=
| E_Abs M :

  EvalComp γ ρ (cAbs M) (Closure n n γ ρ M)

| E_AppAbs n' m q γ1 γ2 γ' γUp H M M' V T T' W ρ':
  EvalComp γ1 ρ M (Closure n' m γ' ρ' M') ->
  EvalVal γ2 ρ V W ->
  γ' = down_env_until γUp n' H ->
  EvalComp (q .: γUp) ((n' W↓ W) .: ρ') M' T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n' T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cApp M V) T

| E_Split q1 q2 γ1 γ2 V N W1 W2 T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Pair W1 W2) ->
  EvalComp (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (W1 .: (W2 .: ρ)) N T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSplit V N) T

| E_Ret V W :
  EvalVal γ ρ V W ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cRet V) (Return W)

| E_LetRet γ1 γ2 q M N W T T' :
  EvalComp γ1 ρ M (Return W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) N T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cLet M N) T

| E_Force mInner mOuter (γ2'' : attrs n) γ1 (γ2 : attrs mOuter) γ2' V M T T' ρ' Hn HInner :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Thunk mOuter mInner γ2 ρ' M) ->
  EvalComp γ2' ρ' M T' ->
  down_env_until γ2' mOuter HInner = γ2 ->
  down_env_until γ2'' mOuter Hn = γ2 ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2'' ->
  T = (mOuter T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cForce V) T

| E_Seq γ1 γ2 V N T :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V Unit ->
  EvalComp γ2 ρ N T ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSeq V N) T

| E_Casel γ1 γ2 q V M1 M2 W T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Inl W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) M1 T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cCase V M1 M2) T

| E_Caser γ1 γ2 q V M1 M2 W T T' :
  EvalVal γ1 ρ V (Inr W) ->
  EvalComp (q .: γ2) (W .: ρ) M2 T' ->
  γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
  T = (n T↓ T') ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cCase V M1 M2) T

| E_CSub M γ' B:
  EvalComp γ' ρ M B ->
  γ γ<= γ' ->

  EvalComp γ ρ (cSub M) B
.

Inductive eq_up_to_attrs : forall (k : Kind), Clos k -> Clos k -> Prop :=
  | Eq_Absent : eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag Absent Absent
  | Eq_Unit : eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag Unit Unit
  | Eq_Thunk n m γ γ' ρ ρ' M :
    (forall i, eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (ρ i) (ρ' i)) ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Thunk n m γ ρ M) (Thunk n m γ' ρ' M)

  | Eq_Pair W1 W2 W1' W2' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W1 W1' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W2 W2' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Pair W1 W2) (Pair W1' W2')

  | Eq_Inl W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Inl W) (Inl W')

  | Eq_Inr W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (Inr W) (Inr W')

  | Eq_Return W W' :
    eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag W W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs CompFlag (Return W) (Return W')

  | Eq_Closure n m γ γ' ρ ρ' M :
    (forall i, eq_up_to_attrs ValFlag (ρ i) (ρ' i)) ->
    eq_up_to_attrs CompFlag (Closure n m γ ρ M) (Closure n m γ' ρ' M)
.

Arguments eq_up_to_attrs {k}.

Definition eq_env_up_to_attrs {n} (ρ1 ρ2 : env n) :=
  forall i, eq_up_to_attrs (ρ1 i) (ρ2 i).

Definition EvalValFail {n} (ρ : env n) V :=
  forall γ W ρ', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> ~ EvalVal γ ρ' V W.

Definition EvalCompFail {n} (ρ : env n) M :=
  forall γ T ρ', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> ~ EvalComp γ ρ' M T.

Require Export strictness.cbpv.syntax.

Require Import Psatz.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Definition context n : Type := fin n -> ValTy n.

Definition ctx_insert {n} (A : ValTy n) (Γ : context n) : context (S n) :=
    (Lazy A↑ A) .: (fun fn => Lazy A↑ (Γ fn)).

Inductive VWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Val n -> ValTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Var i A :
    A = Γ i ->
    γ = (lazyvector <- Strict @ i) ->

    VWt γ Γ (vVar i) A

  | T_Unit :
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ vUnit VUnit

  | T_Thunk γ' M B :
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ = lazyvector ->

    VWt γ Γ (vThunk M) (VThunk γ' B)

  | T_Pair γ1 γ2 V1 V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V1 A1 ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V2 A2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vPair V1 V2) (VProd A1 A2)

  | T_Inl V1 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V1 A1 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInl V1) (VSum A1 A2)

  | T_Inr V2 A1 A2 :
    VWt γ Γ V2 A2 ->

    VWt γ Γ (vInr V2) (VSum A1 A2)

with CWt {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) : Comp n -> CompTy n -> Prop :=
  | T_Ret V A :
    VWt γ Γ V A ->

    CWt γ Γ (cRet V) (CF A)

  | T_Let q M M' A B B' γ1 γ2:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CF A) ->
    CWt (q .: γ2) (ctx_insert A Γ) M' B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cLet M M') B

  | T_Force V B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VThunk γ2 B) ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cForce V) B

  | T_Seq V M B γ1 γ2 :
    VWt γ1 Γ V VUnit ->
    CWt γ2 Γ M B ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSeq V M) B

  | T_Split q1 q2 V M γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B':
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VProd A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: (q2 .: γ2)) (ctx_insert (Lazy A↑ A1) (ctx_insert A2 Γ)) M B' ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (le_succ_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSplit V M) B

  | T_Case q1 q2 V M1 M2 γ1 γ2 A1 A2 B B1 B2:
    VWt γ1 Γ V (VSum A1 A2) ->
    CWt (q1 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A1 Γ) M1 B1 ->
    CWt (q2 .: γ2) (ctx_insert A2 Γ) M2 B2 ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B1 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B2 n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cCase V M1 M2) B

  | T_Abs q M A B B' :
    CWt (q .: γ) (ctx_insert A Γ) M B' ->
    B = (down_compTy_until B' n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)) ->

    CWt γ Γ (cAbs M) (CAbs q A B)

  | T_App M q V γ1 γ2 A B:
    CWt γ1 Γ M (CAbs q A B) ->
    VWt γ2 Γ V A ->
    γ = γ1 γ+ γ2 ->

    CWt γ Γ (cApp M V) B

  | T_CSub M γ' B:
    CWt γ' Γ M B ->
    γ γ<= γ' ->

    CWt γ Γ (cSub M) B
.

Require Export strictness.common.attributes.

Require Export strictness.autosubst2.fintype.

Require Import Psatz.

From Coq Require Export PeanoNat.

From Coq Require Export Bool.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive Kind := ValFlag : Kind | CompFlag : Kind.

Inductive Ty (n : nat) : Kind -> Type :=
  | VUnit : Ty n ValFlag
  | VThunk (γ : attrs n) (B : Ty n CompFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | VProd (A1 : Ty n ValFlag) (A2 : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | VSum (A1 : Ty n ValFlag ) (A2 : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n ValFlag
  | CAbs (q : attr) (A : Ty n ValFlag) (B : Ty n CompFlag) : Ty n CompFlag
  | CF (A : Ty n ValFlag) : Ty n CompFlag
.

Definition ValTy n := Ty n ValFlag.

Definition CompTy n := Ty n CompFlag.

Arguments VUnit {n}.

Arguments VThunk {n}.

Arguments VProd {n}.

Arguments VSum {n}.

Arguments CF {n}.

Arguments CAbs {n}.

Fixpoint ren_ty {n m k} (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (T : Ty n k) : Ty m k :=
  match T with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (ren_ty ξ A1) (ren_ty ξ A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (ren_ty ξ A1) (ren_ty ξ A2)
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (ren_env γ ξ) (ren_ty ξ B)
  | CF A => CF (ren_ty ξ A)
  | CAbs q A B => CAbs q (ren_ty ξ A) (ren_ty ξ B)
  end
.

Definition down_ty {n k} (T : Ty (S n) k) : Ty n k := ren_ty shift T.

Definition down_valTy {n} := @down_ty n ValFlag.

Definition down_compTy {n} := @down_ty n CompFlag.

Notation "'A↓' A" := (down_valTy A) (at level 85).

Notation "'B↓' B" := (down_compTy B) (at level 85).

Fixpoint map_Ty {n m k} (ξ : attrs n -> attrs m) (T : Ty n k) : Ty m k :=
  match T with
  | VUnit => VUnit

  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (map_Ty ξ A1) (map_Ty ξ A2)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (map_Ty ξ A1) (map_Ty ξ A2)
  | CF A => CF (map_Ty ξ A)
  | CAbs q' A B => CAbs q' (map_Ty ξ A) (map_Ty ξ B)
  end

Definition up_Ty {n k} q (T : Ty n k) : Ty (S n) k := map_Ty (fun γ => q .: γ) T.

Definition up_valTy {n} := @up_Ty n ValFlag.

Definition up_compTy {n} := @up_Ty n CompFlag.

Infix "A↑" := (up_valTy) (at level 85).

Infix "B↑" := (up_compTy) (at level 85).

Fixpoint down_ty_until {n k} (A : Ty n k) m (H : m <= n) : Ty m k :=
  match A with
  | VUnit => VUnit
  | VProd A1 A2 => VProd (down_ty_until A1 m H) (down_ty_until A2 m H)
  | VSum A1 A2 => VSum (down_ty_until A1 m H) (down_ty_until A2 m H)
  | VThunk γ B => VThunk (down_env_until γ m H) (down_ty_until B m H)
  | CF A => CF (down_ty_until A m H)
  | CAbs q A B =>
    CAbs q (down_ty_until A m H) (down_ty_until B m H)
  end
.

Definition down_valTy_until {n} := @down_ty_until n ValFlag.

Definition down_compTy_until {n} := @down_ty_until n CompFlag.

  | vThunk (M : Comp n) : Val n


  | vPair (V1 :Val n) (V2: Val n) : Val n


  | vInl (V : Val n) : Val n
  | vInr (V : Val n) : Val n

 with Comp (n : nat) : Type :=

  | cRet (V : Val n) : Comp n

  | cLet (M : Comp n) (M' : Comp (S n)) : Comp n


  | cForce (V : Val n) : Comp n


  | cSeq (V : Val n) (M : Comp n) : Comp n


  | cAbs (M : Comp (S n)) : Comp n

  | cApp (M : Comp n) (V : Val n) : Comp n


  | cSplit (V : Val n) (M : Comp (S (S (n)))) : Comp n


  | cCase (V : Val n) (M1 : Comp (S n)) (M2 : Comp (S n)) : Comp n


  | cSub (V : Comp n) : Comp n

Arguments vUnit {n}.

Arguments vThunk {n}.

Arguments vPair {n}.

Arguments vInl {n}.

Arguments vInr {n}.

Arguments cRet {n}.

Arguments cLet {n}.

Arguments cForce {n}.

Arguments cSeq {n}.

Arguments cAbs {n}.

Arguments cApp {n}.

Arguments cSplit {n}.

Arguments cCase {n}.

    with Comp_ind' := Induction for Comp Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme ValComp_mutual from Val_ind', Comp_ind'.

Definition upRen_Val_Val { m n : nat } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) : fin (S m) -> fin (S n) :=
  up_ren ξ.

Fixpoint ren_Val { m n } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (s : Val m) : Val n :=
    match s return Val n with
    | vVar s => vVar (ξ s)
    | vUnit => vUnit
    | vThunk s0 => vThunk (ren_Comp ξ s0)
    | vPair s0 s1 => vPair (ren_Val ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | vInl s0 => vInl (ren_Val ξ s0)
    | vInr s0 => vInr (ren_Val ξ s0)
    end
 with ren_Comp { m n } (ξ : fin m -> fin n) (s : Comp m) : Comp n :=
    match s return Comp n with
    | cAbs s1 => cAbs (ren_Comp (upRen_Val_Val ξ) s1)
    | cApp s0 s1 => cApp (ren_Comp ξ s0) (ren_Val ξ s1)
    | cForce s0 => cForce (ren_Val ξ s0)

    | cSeq s0 s1 => cSeq (ren_Val ξ s0) (ren_Comp ξ s1)

Require Export strictness.common.fin_util.

From Coq Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.

Require Import Coq.Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Inductive attr : Type :=
    | Lazy
    | Strict
    | Unknown.

Definition attr_le (c1 c2 : attr) :=
    match c1, c2 with
    | Unknown, _ => True
    | Lazy, Lazy => True
    | Strict, Strict => True
    | _, _ => False
    end.

Notation "c1 C<= c2" := (attr_le c1 c2) (at level 60).

Definition attr_stricter (c1 c2 : attr) :=
    match c1, c2 with
    | Strict, _ => True
    | Unknown, _ => True
    | _, Lazy => True
    | _, _ => False
    end.

Notation "c1 'S<=' c2" := (attr_stricter c1 c2) (at level 60).

Definition attr_add (c1 c2 : attr) : attr :=
    match c1, c2 with
    | Lazy, c2 => c2
    | c1, Lazy => c1
    | _, Strict => Strict
    | Strict, _ => Strict
    | _, _ => Unknown
    end.

Notation "c C+ d" := (attr_add c d) (at level 60).

Definition attrs n : Type := fin n -> attr.

Definition ren_env {A n n'} (γ : fin n -> A) (ξ : fin n' -> fin n) : fin n' -> A :=
    fun fn => γ (ξ fn).

Definition lazyvector {n} : attrs n := fun _ => Lazy.

Definition strictvector {n} : attrs n := fun _ => Strict.

Definition attr_vector_add {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) : attrs n :=
    fun fn => γ1 fn C+ γ2 fn.

Notation "c γ+ d" := (attr_vector_add c d) (at level 60).

Definition attr_vector_le {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) : Prop := forall fn,
    γ1 fn C<= γ2 fn.

Notation "γ1 γ<= γ2" := (attr_vector_le γ1 γ2) (at level 50).

Definition attr_vector_stricter {n} (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) : Prop := forall fn,
    γ1 fn S<= γ2 fn.

Notation "γ1 γS<= γ2" := (attr_vector_stricter γ1 γ2) (at level 50).

Definition down_attrs {n} (γ : attrs (S n)) : attrs n := ren_env γ shift.

Notation "'γ↓' γ" := (down_attrs γ) (at level 85).

Definition env_set {n} {A : Type} (ϕ : fin n -> A) (i : fin n) (a : A) :=
    fun fn => if fin_eqb i fn then a else ϕ fn.

Notation "ϕ <- a @ i " := (env_set ϕ i a) (at level 70).

Definition le_minus_plus n m : n <= m -> m = m - n + n := ltac:(lia).
Definition le_succ_succ_diag_r m : m <= S (S m) := ltac:(lia).

Definition up_fin_until : forall {n : nat} (m : nat), n <= m -> ren n m :=
fun (n m : nat) (H : n <= m) =>
(fun fn : fin n =>
 let fn0 := shift_p (m - n) fn in
 let H0 : m = m - n + n := le_minus_plus n m H in
 let fn1 := eq_rec_r (fun n0 : nat => fin n0) fn0 H0 in fn1)
:
ren n m.
Arguments up_fin_until {n} m H _.

Definition down_env_until' {A m} k (γ : fin (k + m) -> A) : fin m -> A :=
    ren_env γ (shift_p k).

Definition down_env_until : forall {A : Type} {n : nat},
       (fin n -> A) -> forall m : nat, m <= n -> fin m -> A :=
fun (A : Type) (n : nat) (γ : fin n -> A) (m : nat) (H : m <= n) =>
let H0 : n - m + m = n :=
  let H0 : n = n - m + m := le_minus_plus m n H in eq_sym H0 in
let γ0 := eq_rect_r (fun n0 : nat => fin n0 -> A) γ H0 in
down_env_until' (n - m) γ0.
Arguments down_env_until {A} {n} 
  γ m H _.

Definition pad_with' : forall {n : nat}, attr -> attrs n -> forall k : nat, attrs (k + n) :=
fun (n : nat) (q : attr) (γ : attrs n) (k : nat) =>
nat_rect (fun k0 : nat => attrs (k0 + n)) (γ : attrs (0 + n))
  (fun (k0 : nat) (IHk : attrs (k0 + n)) =>
   let H : S (k0 + n) = S k0 + n := eq_refl in
   eq_rect (S (k0 + n)) (fun n0 : nat => attrs n0)
     ((fun i : fin (S (k0 + n)) =>
       match i with
       | Some f => (fun f0 : fin (k0 + n) => IHk f0) f
       | None => q
       end)
      :
      attrs (S (k0 + n)))
     (S k0 + n) H)
  k.

Definition pad_with : forall {n : nat}, attr -> attrs n -> forall m : nat, n <= m -> attrs m :=
fun (n : nat) (q : attr) (γ : attrs n) (m : nat) (H : n <= m) =>
let γPad := pad_with' q γ (m - n) in
let HeqγPad : γPad = pad_with' q γ (m - n) := eq_refl in
let H0 : m = m - n + n := le_minus_plus n m H in
let γPad0 := eq_rect_r (fun n0 : nat => attrs n0) γPad H0 in γPad0.
Arguments pad_with {n} q γ m H _.

Definition fin_to_nat : forall {n : nat}, fin (S n) -> nat :=
fix fin_to_nat (n : nat) (f : fin (S n)) {struct n} : nat :=
  match f with
  | Some f0 =>
      (fun f1 : fin n =>
       match n as n0 return (fin n0 -> nat) with
       | 0 => fun f2 : fin 0 => False_rec nat f2
       | S n0 =>
           (fun (n1 : nat) (f2 : fin (S n1)) => S (fin_to_nat n1 f2)) n0
       end f1) f0
  | None => 0
  end.
Arguments fin_to_nat {n} f.
Require Export strictness.autosubst2.fintype.

Definition fin_eqb : forall {n : nat}, fin n -> fin n -> bool :=
fun n : nat =>
nat_rec (fun n0 : nat => fin n0 -> fin n0 -> bool)
  (fun _ H : fin 0 => False_rec bool H)
  (fun (n0 : nat) (IHn : fin n0 -> fin n0 -> bool) (i1 i2 : fin (S n0)) =>
   let f := i1 in
   let H1 : i1 = f := eq_refl in
   match f as o return (i1 = o -> bool) with
   | Some f0 =>
       (fun
          (i1' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                    match n1 with
                    | 0 => False
                    | S m => option (fin m)
                    end)
                   n0)
          (_ : i1 = Some i1') =>
        let f1 := i2 in
        let H2 : i2 = f1 := eq_refl in
        match f1 as o return (i2 = o -> bool) with
        | Some f2 =>
            (fun
               (i2' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                         match n1 with
                         | 0 => False
                         | S m => option (fin m)
                         end)
                        n0)
               (_ : i2 = Some i2') =>
             let b := IHn i1' i2' in
             let IHe : IHn i1' i2' = b := eq_refl in
             (if b as b0 return (IHn i1' i2' = b0 -> bool)
              then fun _ : IHn i1' i2' = true => true
              else fun _ : IHn i1' i2' = false => false) IHe) f2
        | None => fun _ : i2 = None => false
        end H2) f0
   | None =>
       fun _ : i1 = None =>
       let f0 := i2 in
       let H2 : i2 = f0 := eq_refl in
       match f0 as o return (i2 = o -> bool) with
       | Some f1 =>
           (fun
              (i2' : (fix fin (n1 : nat) : Set :=
                        match n1 with
                        | 0 => False
                        | S m => option (fin m)
                        end)
                       n0)
              (_ : i2 = Some i2') =>
            false) f1
       | None => fun _ : i2 = None => true
       end H2
   end H1)
  n.
Arguments fin_eqb {n} _ _.

Definition up_ren' {n} : ren (S n) (S (S n)) := (var_zero .: shift >> shift).

Definition up2_ren' {n} : ren (S (S n)) (S (S (S n))) := (var_zero .: (shift (var_zero) .: shift >> shift >> shift)).

Definition ren_inj {n m} (renamer : ren n m) :=
    (forall i1 i2, renamer i1 = renamer i2 -> i1 = i2).

Definition ren_match {n m X} (renamer : ren n m)
    (fn : fin n -> X) (fm : fin m -> X) :=
    forall i, fn i = fm (renamer i).

Definition default_or_preimage {n m X} (id : X) (fm : fin m -> X) (renamer : ren n m) :=
    (forall j, fm j = id \/ exists i, j = renamer i).

Inductive ren_preimage_cases {n m} (renamer : ren n m) (j : fin m) : Type :=
    | preimage (i : fin n) (H : j = renamer i) : ren_preimage_cases renamer j
    | no_preimage (H : forall (i : fin n), renamer i <> j) : ren_preimage_cases renamer j
    .

Definition env_map {n}{A B} (f : A -> B) (ρ : fin n -> A) : fin n -> B :=
  fun x => f (ρ (x)).

From strictness.cbpv Require Import strict_semtyping.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Local Lemma down_env_lookup {X n m} (f : fin n -> X) (H : m <= n) i :
  down_env_until f m H i = f (up_fin_until n H i).
Proof.
  unfold down_env_until, down_env_until', ren_env, up_fin_until.
  generalize (shift_p (n - m) i), (le_minus_plus m n H).
  generalize (n - m + m).
  intros p e. destruct e. reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma up_fin_same n (H : n <= n) i : up_fin_until n H i = i.
Proof.
  unfold up_fin_until. generalize (le_minus_plus n n H).
  replace (n - n) with 0 by lia. simpl. intros e.
  replace e with (@eq_refl nat n) by (apply UIP_dec; exact Nat.eq_dec).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma up_fin_step m n (H : m <= n) (H' : m <= S n) i :
  up_fin_until (S n) H' i = shift (up_fin_until n H i).
Proof.
  unfold up_fin_until.
  generalize (le_minus_plus m (S n) H').
  replace (S n - m) with (S (n - m)) by lia.
  simpl shift_p.
  generalize (shift_p (n - m) i), (le_minus_plus m n H).
  generalize (n - m + m).
  intros p e. destruct e. intros j e'.
  replace e' with (@eq_refl nat p) by (apply UIP_dec; exact Nat.eq_dec).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma up_fin_compose l m n (Hlm : l <= m) (Hmn : m <= n)
    (Hln : l <= n) i :
  up_fin_until n Hmn (up_fin_until m Hlm i) = up_fin_until n Hln i.
Proof.
  revert Hln. induction Hmn as [|n Hmn IH]; intros Hln.
  - rewrite up_fin_same. f_equal. apply Peano_dec.le_unique.
  - rewrite (up_fin_step _ _ Hmn).
    rewrite (up_fin_step _ _ (Nat.le_trans _ _ _ Hlm Hmn)), IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma attrs_equiv_refl k (C : Clos k) : eq_up_to_attrs C C.
Proof. induction C; constructor; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma attrs_equiv_sym k (C D : Clos k) :
  eq_up_to_attrs C D -> eq_up_to_attrs D C.
Proof. induction 1; constructor; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma attrs_equiv_trans k (C D E : Clos k) :
  eq_up_to_attrs C D -> eq_up_to_attrs D E -> eq_up_to_attrs C E.
Proof.
  intros H. revert E. induction H; intros E HE; inversion HE; subst;
    constructor; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma attrs_equiv_down k (C D : Clos k) s :
  eq_up_to_attrs C D -> eq_up_to_attrs (down_clos s C) (down_clos s D).
Proof. induction 1; simpl; constructor; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma attrs_equiv_cons n W W' (ρ ρ' : env n) :
  eq_up_to_attrs W W' -> eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' ->
  eq_env_up_to_attrs (W .: ρ) (W' .: ρ').
Proof. intros HW Hρ [j|]; [apply Hρ | exact HW]. Qed.

Theorem strict_explosion : forall n (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) (ρ : env n) i,
  ρ_not_ok γ ρ Γ n i ltac:(auto) ->
  (forall V A, VWt γ Γ V A -> EvalValFail ρ V) /\\
  (forall M A, CWt γ Γ M (CF A) -> EvalCompFail ρ M).

  intros C l x (o & m & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hon & Hom & Hlo & Hlm & Hi & -> & HC).
  exists o, m, δ, δi, ρ, M, Hon, Hom, Hlo, Hlm.
  split; [exact Hi|]. split; [reflexivity|].
  intros W HW. specialize (HC W HW).
  apply strict_comp_result in HC.
  destruct HC as [HF | (T & HE & HT)]; [left|right]; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma result_lr_trim n (B : CompTy n) T m (H : m <= n) l (x : fin l) s b :
  l <= s -> s <= m ->
  result_lr B l x b T ->
  result_lr (down_ty_until B m H) l x b (down_clos s T).
Proof.
  destruct b; intros; [eapply (proj1 (proj2 (lr_scope n _ B m H l x))) |
    eapply lr_maybe_trim]; eauto.
Qed.

Local Definition missing_env {n} (Γ : context n) (ρ : env n) l (x : fin l)
    (H : l <= n) :=
  ρ (up_fin_until n H x) = Absent /\\
  forall j, j <> up_fin_until n H x -> LR_maybe (Γ j) (ρ j) l x.

Local Lemma missing_env_cons n (Γ : context n) (ρ : env n) A W l (x : fin l)
    (H : l <= n) (H' : l <= S n) :
  missing_env Γ ρ l x H -> LR_maybe A W l x ->
  missing_env (ctx_insert A Γ) (W .: ρ) l x H'.
Proof.
  intros [HM HΓ] HW. unfold missing_env. rewrite (up_fin_step _ _ H).
  split; [exact HM|].
  intros [j|] Hne; cbn [ctx_insert scons].
  - eapply (lr_maybe_lift (S n) _ _ _ n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)).
    change (LR_maybe (down_ty_until (up_Ty Lazy (Γ j)) n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n))
      (ρ j) l x).
    rewrite down_ty_lift. apply HΓ. intros ->. apply Hne. reflexivity.
  - eapply (lr_maybe_lift (S n) _ _ _ n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n)).
    change (LR_maybe (down_ty_until (up_Ty Lazy A) n (Nat.le_succ_diag_r n))
      W l x).
    rewrite down_ty_lift. exact HW.
Qed.

Local Definition is_strict (a : attr) : bool :=
  match a with Strict => true | _ => false end.

Local Definition strict_at {n} (γ : attrs n) l (x : fin l) (H : l <= n) :=
  is_strict (γ (up_fin_until n H x)).

Local Lemma strict_at_add n (γ1 γ2 : attrs n) l (x : fin l) (H : l <= n) :
  strict_at (γ1 γ+ γ2) l x H =
  strict_at γ1 l x H || strict_at γ2 l x H.
Proof. unfold strict_at, attr_vector_add. destruct (γ1 _), (γ2 _); reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma strict_at_cons n q (γ : attrs n) l (x : fin l) (H : l <= n) (H' : l <= S n) :
  strict_at (q .: γ) l x H' = strict_at γ l x H.
Proof. unfold strict_at. rewrite (up_fin_step _ _ H). reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma strict_at_scoped n m o l (x : fin l) (γ : attrs n) (δ : attrs m)
    (Hln : l <= n) (Hlm : l <= m) (Hlo : l <= o) (Hon : o <= n) (Hom : o <= m) :
  down_env_until γ o Hon = down_env_until δ o Hom ->
  strict_at γ l x Hln = strict_at δ l x Hlm.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold strict_at. f_equal.
  rewrite <- (up_fin_compose _ _ _ Hlo Hon Hln), <- down_env_lookup, E, down_env_lookup.
  apply f_equal, up_fin_compose.
Qed.

Local Lemma lr_absent n (A : ValTy n) l (x : fin l) : ~ LR_maybe A Absent l x.
Proof.
  assert (P : forall k (B : Ty n k),
    match k return Ty n k -> Prop with
    | ValFlag => fun A => ~ LR_maybe A Absent l x
    | CompFlag => fun _ => True
    end B).
  { destruct B; cbn [LR_maybe]; intros; auto; intros H;
      repeat (destruct H as [H|H]); discriminate. }
  exact (P ValFlag A).
Qed.

Local Lemma strict_fin_eqb n (i j : fin n) : fin_eqb i j = true <-> i = j.
Proof.
  revert i j. induction n; intros i j; [destruct i|].
  destruct i as [i|], j as [j|]; simpl;
    try (split; congruence).
  destruct (fin_eqb i j) eqn:E; simpl; split; intros H; try discriminate.
  - f_equal. apply IHn. exact E.
  - reflexivity.
  - injection H as ->. assert (fin_eqb j j = true) by (apply IHn; reflexivity).
    congruence.
Qed.

Local Definition value_result {n} (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) V (A : ValTy n)
    l (x : fin l) (H : l <= n) :=
  EvalValFail ρ V \\/ (strict_at γ l x H = false /\\
    exists W, EvalVal γ ρ V W /\\ LR_maybe A W l x).

Local Definition typed_val_property {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) V (A : ValTy n) :=
  forall ρ l (x : fin l) (H : l <= n), missing_env Γ ρ l x H ->
  value_result γ ρ V A l x H.

Local Definition typed_comp_property {n} (γ : attrs n) (Γ : context n) M (B : CompTy n) :=
  forall ρ l (x : fin l) (H : l <= n), missing_env Γ ρ l x H ->
  comp_result B l x (strict_at γ l x H) γ ρ M (fun T => T).

Local Lemma comp_result_unwrap n (γ : attrs n) (ρ : env n) M A l (x : fin l) b :
  comp_result (CF A) l x b γ ρ M (fun T => T) ->
  EvalCompFail ρ M \\/ (b = false /\\ exists W, EvalComp γ ρ M (Return W) /\\ LR_maybe A W l x).
Proof.
  intros [HF | (T & HE & HT)]; [left; exact HF|].
  destruct b; [contradiction|].
  destruct HT as (W & -> & HW). right. eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma comp_result_trim n m j (B : CompTy n) (H : m <= n)
    l (x : fin l) b (δ : attrs j) ρ M :
  l <= m ->
  comp_result B l x b δ ρ M (fun T => T) ->
  comp_result (down_ty_until B m H) l x b δ ρ M (fun T => m T↓ T).
Proof.
  intros Hl [HF | (T & HE & HT)]; [left; exact HF|].
  right. exists T. split; [exact HE|].
  eapply result_lr_trim; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma closure_result n q (A : ValTy n) B l (x : fin l) b T :
  result_lr (CAbs q A B) l x b T ->
  exists o m δ δi ρ M (Hom : o <= m),
    δ = down_env_until δi o Hom /\\ T = Closure o m δ ρ M /\\
    forall W, LR_maybe A W l x ->
    comp_result B l x b (q .: δi) ((o W↓ W) .: ρ) M (fun U => o T↓ U).
Proof.
  destruct b; cbn [result_lr LR_maybe LR_no]; intros
    (o & m & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hon & Hom & Hlo & Hlm & Hδ & -> & HC);
    exists o, m, δ, δi, ρ, M, Hom; split; [symmetry; exact Hδ|];
    split; [reflexivity|]; intros W HW; specialize (HC W HW).
  - apply strict_comp_result. exact HC.
  - exact HC.
Qed.

Local Ltac contradict_eval :=
  match goal with
  | H : EvalValFail _ _ |- False => eapply H; [|eassumption];
      eauto 8 using attrs_equiv_cons, attrs_equiv_down
  | H : EvalCompFail _ _ |- False => eapply H; [|eassumption];
      eauto 8 using attrs_equiv_cons, attrs_equiv_down
  end.

Local Ltac compare_eval Henv Hwet HW :=
  lazymatch type of Henv with
  | eq_env_up_to_attrs ?r ?r' =>
    lazymatch type of Hwet with
    | EvalVal _ r ?V _ =>
        match goal with H : EvalVal _ r' V _ |- _ =>
          pose proof (strict_eval_val_unique _ _ _ _ _ Hwet _ _ _ Henv H) as HW
        end
    | EvalComp _ r ?M _ =>
        match goal with H : EvalComp _ r' M _ |- _ =>
          pose proof (strict_eval_comp_unique _ _ _ _ _ Hwet _ _ _ Henv H) as HW
        end
    end
  end.

Local Ltac fail_eval :=
  let HE := fresh \"HE\" in

  forall γ' ρ' W', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> EvalVal γ' ρ' V W' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs W W'.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros γe ρe We Heq He; strict_invert He;
    eauto using eq_up_to_attrs.
Qed.

Local Lemma strict_eval_comp_unique n γ (ρ : env n) M T :
  EvalComp γ ρ M T ->
  forall γ' ρ' T', eq_env_up_to_attrs ρ ρ' -> EvalComp γ' ρ' M T' ->
    eq_up_to_attrs T T'.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros γe ρe Te Heq He; strict_invert He;
    try solve [eauto using eq_up_to_attrs, strict_eval_val_unique].
  all: try match goal with
  | Henv : eq_env_up_to_attrs ?r ?r',
    H1 : EvalVal _ ?r ?V _, H2 : EvalVal _ ?r' ?V _ |- _ =>
      let HW := fresh "HW" in
      pose proof (strict_eval_val_unique _ _ _ _ _ H1 _ _ _ Henv H2) as HW;
      try solve [inversion HW]
  end.
  - match goal with
    | H : EvalComp _ ρe _ (Closure _ _ _ _ _) |- _ =>
        pose proof (IHEvalComp1 _ _ _ Heq H) as HF
    end.
    strict_invert HF.
    apply attrs_equiv_down. eapply IHEvalComp2; [|eassumption].
    apply attrs_equiv_cons; [apply attrs_equiv_down |]; assumption.
  - strict_invert HW. apply attrs_equiv_down. eapply IHEvalComp; [|eassumption].
    repeat apply attrs_equiv_cons; assumption.
  - match goal with
    | H : EvalComp _ ρe _ (Return _) |- _ =>
        pose proof (IHEvalComp1 _ _ _ Heq H) as HR
    end.
    strict_invert HR. apply attrs_equiv_down. eapply IHEvalComp2; [|eassumption].
    apply attrs_equiv_cons; assumption.
  - strict_invert HW. apply attrs_equiv_down. eapply IHEvalComp; eassumption.
  - strict_invert HW. apply attrs_equiv_down. eapply IHEvalComp; [|eassumption].
    apply attrs_equiv_cons; assumption.
  - strict_invert HW. apply attrs_equiv_down. eapply IHEvalComp; [|eassumption].
    apply attrs_equiv_cons; assumption.
Qed.

Local Definition lr_scope_change {n k} (R : forall n, Ty n k -> Clos k ->
    forall l, fin l -> Prop) (A : Ty n k) m (H : m <= n) l (x : fin l) :=
  (forall C s, l <= s -> s <= m -> R n A C l x ->
    R m (down_ty_until A m H) (down_clos s C) l x) /\
  (forall C, R m (down_ty_until A m H) C l x -> R n A C l x).

Local Lemma lr_scope n k (A : Ty n k) :
  forall m (H : m <= n) l (x : fin l),
  lr_scope_change (fun n => @LR_maybe n k) A m H l x /\
  lr_scope_change (fun n => @LR_no n k) A m H l x.
Proof.
  induction A as [|γ B IHB|A IHA B IHB|A IHA B IHB|q A IHA B IHB|A IHA];
    intros m H l x; unfold lr_scope_change in *;
    (try specialize (IHA m H l x) as [[trimA liftA] _]);
    (try specialize (IHB m H l x) as [[trimB liftB] [trimNo liftNo]]);
    repeat split; try (intros; contradiction).
  - intros C s Hls Hsm HC. cbn [LR_maybe] in HC. subst. reflexivity.
  - intros C HC. exact HC.
  - intros C s Hls Hsm HC.
    cbn [LR_maybe] in HC.
    destruct HC as (o & inner & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hoi & Hon & Hlo & Hli &
      Hδ & Hi & -> & HC).
    set (r := Nat.min o s).
    assert (Hlr : l <= r) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hrm : r <= m) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hri : r <= inner) by (unfold r; lia).
    cbn [down_ty_until LR_maybe down_clos].
    exists r, inner, (down_env_until δ r (min_le o s)), δi, ρ, M,
      Hri, Hrm, Hlr, Hli.
    split.
    { erewrite down_env_compose. rewrite <- Hδ. erewrite down_env_compose. reflexivity. }
    split.
    { rewrite <- Hi. erewrite down_env_compose. reflexivity. }
    split; [reflexivity|].
    pose proof (@lr_results_map n m inner B (down_ty_until B m H) l x δi ρ M
      (fun T => o T↓ T) (fun T => r T↓ T)) as Hmap.
    specialize (Hmap (non_func_down n m B H)).
    assert (Hr : r <= o) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hm : forall T, LR_maybe B (o T↓ T) l x ->
      LR_maybe (down_ty_until B m H) (r T↓ T) l x).
    { intros T HT. unfold down_comp in *. rewrite <- (down_clos_smaller _ T r o Hr). eauto. }
    assert (Hn : forall T, LR_no B (o T↓ T) l x ->
      LR_no (down_ty_until B m H) (r T↓ T) l x).
    { intros T HT. unfold down_comp in *. rewrite <- (down_clos_smaller _ T r o Hr). eauto. }
    destruct (Hmap Hm Hn) as [HM HN].
    unfold LRM in *. split; intros HS; [apply HN; exact (proj1 HC HS) | apply HM; exact (proj2 HC HS)].
  - intros C HC. cbn [down_ty_until LR_maybe] in HC.
    destruct HC as (o & inner & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hoi & Hom & Hlo & Hli &
      Hδ & Hi & -> & HC).
    assert (Hon : o <= n) by lia.
    cbn [LR_maybe].
    exists o, inner, δ, δi, ρ, M, Hoi, Hon, Hlo, Hli.
    split; [rewrite <- Hδ; erewrite down_env_compose; reflexivity|].
    split; [exact Hi|]. split; [reflexivity|].
    destruct (@lr_results_map m n inner (down_ty_until B m H) B l x δi ρ M
      (fun T => o T↓ T) (fun T => o T↓ T) (iff_sym (non_func_down n m B H))
      (fun T => liftB (o T↓ T)) (fun T => liftNo (o T↓ T))) as [HM HN].
    unfold LRM in *. split; intros HS; [apply HN; exact (proj1 HC HS) | apply HM; exact (proj2 HC HS)].
  - intros C s Hls Hsm (U & V & -> & HU & HV).
    exists (down_clos s U), (down_clos s V). eauto.
  - intros C (U & V & -> & HU & HV). exists U, V. eauto.
  - intros C s Hls Hsm (W & [(-> & HW) | (-> & HW)]);
      exists (down_clos s W); [left | right]; eauto.
  - intros C (W & [(-> & HW) | (-> & HW)]); exists W; [left | right]; eauto.
  - intros C s Hls Hsm HC.
    cbn [LR_maybe LR_no] in HC.
    destruct HC as (o & inner & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hon & Hoi & Hlo & Hli &
      Hi & -> & HC).
    set (r := Nat.min o s).
    assert (Hr : r <= o) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hlr : l <= r) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hrm : r <= m) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hri : r <= inner) by (unfold r; lia).
    cbn [down_ty_until LR_maybe LR_no down_clos].
    exists r, inner, (down_env_until δ r (min_le o s)), δi, ρ, M,
      Hrm, Hri, Hlr, Hli.
    split; [rewrite <- Hi; erewrite down_env_compose; reflexivity |].
    split; [reflexivity |]. intros W HW.
    assert (HW' : LR_maybe A (r W↓ W) l x) by (apply liftA, trimA; auto).
    specialize (HC _ HW').
    unfold down_value in HC. rewrite down_clos_larger in HC by exact Hr.
    assert (HM : forall T, LR_maybe B (o T↓ T) l x ->
      LR_maybe (down_ty_until B m H) (r T↓ T) l x).
    { intros T HT. unfold down_comp in *. rewrite <- (down_clos_smaller _ T r o Hr).
      eauto. }
    assert (HN : forall T, LR_no B (o T↓ T) l x ->
      LR_no (down_ty_until B m H) (r T↓ T) l x).
    { intros T HT. unfold down_comp in *. rewrite <- (down_clos_smaller _ T r o Hr).
      eauto. }
    apply (proj1 (@lr_results_map n m (S inner) B (down_ty_until B m H)
      l x (q .: δi) ((r W↓ W) .: ρ) M (fun T => o T↓ T) (fun T => r T↓ T)
      (non_func_down n m B H) HM HN)).
    exact HC.
  - intros C HC. cbn [down_ty_until LR_maybe LR_no] in HC.
    destruct HC as (o & inner & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hom & Hoi & Hlo & Hli &
      Hi & -> & HC).
    assert (Hon : o <= n) by lia.
    cbn [LR_maybe LR_no].
    exists o, inner, δ, δi, ρ, M, Hon, Hoi, Hlo, Hli.
    split; [exact Hi |]. split; [reflexivity |]. intros W HW.
    assert (HW' : LR_maybe (down_ty_until A m H) (o W↓ W) l x)
      by (apply trimA; auto).
    specialize (HC _ HW').
    unfold down_value in HC. rewrite down_clos_larger in HC by lia.
    apply (proj1 (@lr_results_map m n (S inner) (down_ty_until B m H) B
      l x (q .: δi) ((o W↓ W) .: ρ) M (fun T => o T↓ T) (fun T => o T↓ T)
      (iff_sym (non_func_down n m B H)) (fun T => liftB _) (fun T => liftNo _))).
    exact HC.
  - intros C s Hls Hsm HC.
    cbn [LR_maybe LR_no] in HC.
    destruct HC as (o & inner & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hon & Hoi & Hlo & Hli &
      Hi & -> & HC).
    set (r := Nat.min o s).
    assert (Hr : r <= o) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hlr : l <= r) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hrm : r <= m) by (unfold r; lia).
    assert (Hri : r <= inner) by (unfold r; lia).
    cbn [down_ty_until LR_maybe LR_no down_clos].
    exists r, inner, (down_env_until δ r (min_le o s)), δi, ρ, M,
      Hrm, Hri, Hlr, Hli.
    split; [rewrite <- Hi; erewrite down_env_compose; reflexivity |].
    split; [reflexivity |]. intros W HW.
    assert (HW' : LR_maybe A (r W↓ W) l x) by (apply liftA, trimA; auto).
    specialize (HC _ HW').
    unfold down_value in HC. rewrite down_clos_larger in HC by exact Hr.
    assert (HM : forall T, LR_maybe B (o T↓ T) l x ->
      LR_maybe (down_ty_until B m H) (r T↓ T) l x).
    { intros T HT. unfold down_comp in *. rewrite <- (down_clos_smaller _ T r o Hr).
      eauto. }
    assert (HN : forall T, LR_no B (o T↓ T) l x ->
      LR_no (down_ty_until B m H) (r T↓ T) l x).
    { intros T HT. unfold down_comp in *. rewrite <- (down_clos_smaller _ T r o Hr).
      eauto. }
    apply (proj2 (@lr_results_map n m (S inner) B (down_ty_until B m H)
      l x (q .: δi) ((r W↓ W) .: ρ) M (fun T => o T↓ T) (fun T => r T↓ T)
      (non_func_down n m B H) HM HN)).
    exact HC.
  - intros C HC. cbn [down_ty_until LR_maybe LR_no] in HC.
    destruct HC as (o & inner & δ & δi & ρ & M & Hom & Hoi & Hlo & Hli &
      Hi & -> & HC).
    assert (Hon : o <= n) by lia.
    cbn [LR_maybe LR_no].
    exists o, inner, δ, δi, ρ, M, Hon, Hoi, Hlo, Hli.
    split; [exact Hi |]. split; [reflexivity |]. intros W HW.
    assert (HW' : LR_maybe (down_ty_until A m H) (o W↓ W) l x)
      by (apply trimA; auto).
    specialize (HC _ HW').
    unfold down_value in HC. rewrite down_clos_larger in HC by lia.
    apply (proj2 (@lr_results_map m n (S inner) (down_ty_until B m H) B
      l x (q .: δi) ((o W↓ W) .: ρ) M (fun T => o T↓ T) (fun T => o T↓ T)
      (iff_sym (non_func_down n m B H)) (fun T => liftB _) (fun T => liftNo _))).
    exact HC.
  - intros C s Hls Hsm (W & -> & HW). exists (down_clos s W). eauto.
  - intros C (W & -> & HW). exists W. eauto.
  Unshelve. all: lia.
Qed.

Local Lemma lr_maybe_trim n k (A : Ty n k) C m (H : m <= n) l (x : fin l) s :
  l <= s -> s <= m ->
  LR_maybe A C l x -> LR_maybe (down_ty_until A m H) (down_clos s C) l x.
Proof. exact (proj1 (proj1 (lr_scope n k A m H l x)) C s). Qed.

Local Lemma lr_maybe_lift n k (A : Ty n k) C m (H : m <= n) l (x : fin l) :
  LR_maybe (down_ty_until A m H) C l x -> LR_maybe A C l x.
Proof. exact (proj2 (proj1 (lr_scope n k A m H l x)) C). Qed.
